args.script:
# Get the actual file sizes in bytes for all .txt files
total_bytes=0
for f in files_directory/*.txt; do
    size=$(stat -c%s "$f")
    total_bytes=$((total_bytes + size))
done
echo "Total bytes: $total_bytes"
# Convert to KB (1 KB = 1024 bytes)
total_kb=$((total_bytes / 1024))
echo "Total KB (integer): $total_kb"
